data.spiritual_meaning: Sharanu is a name that represents the divine protector and the one who provides refuge to the distressed. It is believed that the name carries the energy of the deity Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, wisdom, and protection. The name is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Sharanu is a powerful reminder of the divine presence that protects and guides us through life's challenges.

historical_references.reference: Sharanu was an important Vedic deity, mentioned in the Rigveda and other early Hindu texts. He was identified with the Ashvini twins, the divine physicians who healed the wounded and protected travelers. Shanaru was also invoked to bring rain and to ensure a bountiful harvest.

Sharanu is also mentioned in the Mahabharata, an epic Sanskrit poem, as one of the names of the god Krishna. Krishna, in his role as a protector and advisor to the Pandava brothers, assumed various disguises and assumed different names, including Sharanu. This name was used to signify that Krishna was a refuge for the Pandavas, and that they could seek his protection and guidance.
